text:
Nadia (AE): Heads-up 3: Orbital Partners wants an exec sync. Two blockers: BYO-KMS + HSM attestation, and a short-term pricing concession request. They want answers before EOD.

Ravi (SE): Reproduced KMS rejection in our sandbox. Their key policy omits our service principal. Quick ask: can they add our role ARN to the key policy for the pilot? If yes we can route to a Dedicated pod.

Lena (ProdOps): We can stand up a locked-down dedicated cluster (orb-ded-01). Need role ARN + IP ranges. Provision ETA ~20-30m once data is in.

Marcus (Finance): Pricing constraint: we can offer a 12-week trial credit + 10% temporary concession with ARR commit. Anything deeper needs VP approval.

Jin (Security): For pilot acceptance we need: HSM attestation (PDF), key rotation timeline, audit log export cadence, and admin SSO + MFA confirmation. For short pilots we accept signed attestation from their infra lead.

Nadia (AE): Plan: quick pre-sync 30m, then exec bridge with CTO/CFO. Owners: Ravi (tech), Jin (sec), Lena (ops), Marcus (finance). Can everyone join pre-sync 09:30 PT?

Ravi (SE): +1. I'll prepare the policy snippet to send and a test case to demo.

Lena (ProdOps): +1. I'll start provisioning once we get their ARN.

Marcus (Finance): +1. I'll draft the concession note and attach criteria.

Jin (Security): +1. I'll prepare the minimal attestation checklist.

Nadia (AE): Great. Orbital says they'll send the role ARN within 45m. I'll post the calendar invite and include the pre-read.

Ravi (SE): Policy snippet to send (replace ROLE_ARN):

`{
  "Version": "2012-10-17",
  "Statement": [{
    "Effect": "Allow",
    "Principal": {"AWS": "ROLE_ARN"},
    "Action": ["kms:Encrypt","kms:Decrypt","kms:GenerateDataKey"],
    "Resource": "*"
  }]
}`

Lena (ProdOps): IP allowlist template: 10.20.30.0/24. They should return CIDRs.

Nadia (AE): Thanks team 3. I'll update when ARN + CIDRs arrive.
